description.en: The number of resources to return.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

description.zh:
标签列表。

一次最多支持查询20个标签。
description.en:
The list of tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
标签键。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
标签值。

标签值最多支持128个字符，可以为空字符串。
description.en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It can be an empty string.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-tag-resources --resource-type ALIYUN::FC::FUNCTION --resource-id acs:fc:cn-shanghai:1234/functions/my-func --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
